verdict.rationale: A CLI is a fair question for a GPU platform, since its driver and toolkit ecosystem could ship one, so the axis applies. The only relevant evidence is that the official CUDA Toolkit ships a C/C++ compiler plus debugging and optimization tools (Nsight Compute and Nsight Systems), which suggests command-line developer tooling but never names it as a CLI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official CLI, any coverage of its use in AI-native or agent workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
